name: ASP.NET Core Web Development
tools: VS Code with C# Dev Kit

beginner.summary: For C# developers starting web work on ASP.NET Core. Covers project templates and hosting, the middleware pipeline and routing, minimal APIs, controllers and model binding, dependency injection lifetimes, configuration and options, logging, EF Core per request, validation and ProblemDetails, OpenAPI documents, Razor Pages, MVC views and tag helpers, Blazor components, cookie authentication and Identity, authorization policies, static files and CORS, HttpClientFactory, endpoint tests and publishing to IIS, Linux and containers.
prerequisites: Writes C# classes, methods, LINQ and async/await
Knows what a relational database is
outcomes: Build web APIs and server-rendered sites with ASP.NET Core
Configure the pipeline, dependency injection, data access and security
Choose between minimal APIs, controllers, Razor Pages, MVC and Blazor
Test and publish ASP.NET Core applications

days.topic: ASP.NET Core Overview and Project Setup
subtopics: What ASP.NET Core is and where it runs
Long-term support and standard-term support releases
Installing the .NET SDK and checking versions
Project templates: web, webapi, razor, mvc and blazor
The Program.cs entry point and WebApplication builder
Choosing an editor: Visual Studio, VS Code or Rider
days.lab_task: Create one project from each main template, run them with dotnet watch, compare their Program.cs files and project files, and switch environments with launch profiles.
days.deliverable: Five template projects with comparison notes
checks: Code change appears without restarting the app
Development and Production behave differently as configured
Differences in Program.cs explained for each template
objectives: Create and run projects from templates

days.topic: The Request Pipeline: Hosting, Middleware and Routing
subtopics: How a request moves through Kestrel and middleware
days.lab_task: Write three inline middleware components that log, time and short-circuit requests, place them in different orders, add routes with constraints and explain each result.
checks: Logged order matches the registration order
Request ends before reaching the endpoint

days.topic: Minimal APIs: Endpoints, Route Groups and Parameter Binding
subtopics: Parameter binding from route, query, header and body
Route groups with shared prefixes and filters
Endpoint metadata such as names and tags
When minimal APIs are the right choice
days.lab_task: Build a minimal API for a to-do service with route groups, typed results, validation and binding from every source, organised into endpoint extension methods.
days.deliverable: Minimal API with an HTTP request file
checks: Values from route, query, header and body all bound
OpenAPI shows each possible response type

days.topic: Controllers and Model Binding in ASP.NET Core
days.lab_task: Rebuild the to-do service with controllers using attribute routing, binding attributes, model state, an action filter for timing and content negotiation for JSON and XML.
days.deliverable: Controller-based API and a comparison with the minimal version
checks: Response returned as XML when asked
Trade-offs of controllers and minimal APIs recorded

days.topic: Dependency Injection Lifetimes and Service Registration
subtopics: Using services in middleware and endpoints
days.lab_task: Register services with each lifetime, log instance IDs across requests, reproduce a captive dependency bug, turn on scope validation and fix it, then use keyed services for two payment providers.
checks: Lifetimes behave as expected across requests
Scope validation reports the problem at start-up

days.topic: Configuration, Options and Environments in ASP.NET Core
days.lab_task: Bind email and payment settings to typed options with validation, override them with environment variables, store secrets in user secrets and reload a feature flag without restarting.
checks: App fails at start-up with a clear message
Changed flag takes effect without a restart
objectives: Keep secrets out of source control

days.topic: Logging with ILogger and Structured Logs
subtopics: Writing logs to Seq or files with Serilog
days.lab_task: Add structured logging with message templates and scopes, source-generated log methods for hot paths, HTTP logging with redaction and a Seq sink, then query the logs.
checks: Logs filtered by order ID in Seq
Request ID attached to every log line in a request

days.topic: EF Core with ASP.NET Core: DbContext per Request and Migrations
days.lab_task: Add EF Core to the to-do service with a scoped context, migrations, development seed data and context pooling, and fix a bug caused by sharing a context across threads.
checks: No concurrent use exceptions under load
Context pooling active with no behaviour change
objectives: Use EF Core in web apps

days.topic: Validation and ProblemDetails Responses
days.lab_task: Validate requests with data annotations and FluentValidation, return RFC-style problem details for every error, handle unhandled exceptions with IExceptionHandler and document the error format.
checks: Validation problem details list each field
Handler returns problem details without a stack trace
Status code page returns problem details

days.topic: OpenAPI Documents with Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi and Scalar
subtopics: Endpoint metadata for summaries and responses
Scalar or Swagger UI for exploring APIs
Several documents for several API groups
days.lab_task: Generate OpenAPI documents for the to-do service with summaries, responses and a bearer security scheme, explore them in Scalar, export at build time and generate a client.
days.deliverable: OpenAPI documents and a generated client
checks: Authorised calls work from the UI
Generated client compiles and calls the API

days.topic: Razor Pages for Server-Rendered Sites
subtopics: Model binding and validation in forms
Tag helpers for forms and links
days.lab_task: Build a Razor Pages site for event listings with a layout, partials, validated create and edit forms with tag helpers, post-redirect-get and antiforgery protection.
checks: Field errors shown next to inputs
No duplicate submission thanks to post-redirect-get

days.topic: MVC Views, Tag Helpers and Layouts
subtopics: The MVC pattern in ASP.NET Core
Strongly typed views and view models
days.lab_task: Build an admin area with MVC controllers and strongly typed views, a view component for a dashboard widget, custom tag helpers and editor templates.
checks: Tag helper outputs the expected markup
Admin routes separated in their own area
objectives: Use view models and view components

days.topic: Blazor Components and Render Modes
subtopics: Interactive server and WebAssembly render modes
days.lab_task: Build a Blazor event booking page with components and parameters, a validated EditForm, data from the API, and compare static, server and WebAssembly render modes.
days.deliverable: Blazor booking page with render mode notes
checks: Validation errors shown in the EditForm
Page works in each render mode

days.topic: Cookie Authentication and ASP.NET Core Identity UI
days.lab_task: Add Identity to the Razor Pages site with registration, email confirmation, lockout, password rules and secure cookies, and protect pages for signed-in users.
checks: Auth cookie is HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite

days.topic: Authorization Policies, Requirements and Handlers
days.lab_task: Add policies for organisers and admins, a requirement that only event owners may edit, resource-based checks in handlers and a fallback policy that protects every endpoint by default.
checks: Request denied by the resource handler
Fallback policy protects it without extra code
Each policy tested for allowed and denied users

days.topic: Static Files, CORS and HTTPS Settings
days.lab_task: Serve static assets with fingerprinting and caching, add a CORS policy for one front-end origin, enable HTTPS redirection and HSTS, and configure forwarded headers behind a proxy.
checks: Fingerprinted assets served with long cache headers
Only the allowed origin passes CORS
App sees the original scheme and client IP

days.topic: Calling Other APIs with HttpClientFactory
days.lab_task: Call a public weather API through a typed client with a message handler for headers, timeouts and the standard resilience handler, and unit-test it with a fake handler.
checks: Resilience handler retries and then fails clearly

days.topic: Testing ASP.NET Core Endpoints with xUnit and WebApplicationFactory
subtopics: Testing Razor Pages and minimal APIs
days.lab_task: Write unit tests for services and in-memory integration tests for the API and Razor Pages with replaced services, a test database and an authenticated test user.
checks: Endpoints tested through the full pipeline
Test swaps the email sender for a fake
Protected endpoints tested as a signed-in user

days.topic: Publishing ASP.NET Core to IIS, Linux and Containers
subtopics: Hosting on IIS with the ASP.NET Core Module
Running on Linux behind NGINX with systemd
days.lab_task: Publish the app to IIS, to a Linux server behind NGINX with systemd and as a container image built by dotnet publish, and smoke test each deployment.
days.deliverable: Three deployments and a deployment guide
checks: Site runs under the ASP.NET Core Module
systemd restarts the app after a crash
Image built by dotnet publish runs the app
objectives: Host on IIS, Linux and containers

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Event Registration Web App and API
days.lab_task: Build an event registration product with a public site, an admin area, a minimal API, Identity sign-in, authorization policies, validation, tests and a container deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, running deployment and demo recording
checks: Registration, admin and API flows work end to end
Deployed container serves the site and API
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one product
Build a complete ASP.NET Core app

intermediate.summary: For developers who already build ASP.NET Core applications. Covers custom middleware and endpoint filters, rate limiting and request timeouts, output caching and HybridCache, hosted services and channels, SignalR scale-out, gRPC, token validation and the BFF pattern, Identity endpoints and passkeys, data protection and antiforgery, API versioning, health checks, metrics and tracing, resilience, Blazor forms and state, localisation, large uploads, Kestrel performance, .NET Aspire and OWASP risks.
prerequisites: Has built and deployed an ASP.NET Core API or site
Comfortable with dependency injection, EF Core and authentication basics
outcomes: Extend the pipeline with middleware, filters, caching and limits
Build real-time, gRPC and background features
Secure, observe and tune ASP.NET Core applications
Run applications with containers and .NET Aspire

days.topic: Advanced Middleware: Custom Middleware, Short-Circuiting and Endpoint Filters
subtopics: Action and result filters for controllers
days.lab_task: Write factory-based middleware for correlation IDs, endpoint filters for validation and auditing, a short-circuit route for health pings and tests for each.
days.deliverable: Middleware and filter library with tests
checks: Factory middleware gets a fresh scoped service per request
Endpoint filter rejects bad input before the handler

days.topic: Rate Limiting and Request Timeouts Middleware
subtopics: Fixed window, sliding window, token bucket and concurrency limiters
Partitioning limits by user or IP
days.lab_task: Add per-user token bucket limits to write endpoints, a concurrency limiter for a slow report, request timeouts with cancellation honoured in EF Core queries and load tests that show each behaviour.
days.deliverable: Limits and timeouts configuration with test results
checks: Slow query cancelled at the timeout
Concurrency limiter caps active report requests

days.topic: Output Caching, Response Caching and HybridCache
days.lab_task: Cache public list endpoints with tagged output caching, evict by tag on updates, cache expensive lookups with HybridCache over Redis and measure latency under load.
checks: Updated data visible right after eviction
One factory call for many concurrent misses

days.topic: Background Work: Hosted Services, Channels and Queues
subtopics: When to move to an external queue
days.lab_task: Build an in-process email queue with channels and a background service, a periodic clean-up job, scoped database access inside workers and graceful shutdown that drains the queue.
checks: Requests return fast while the worker sends emails
Worker drains the queue before shutdown
Error logged and the worker keeps running
objectives: Run background work in ASP.NET Core

days.topic: SignalR Hubs, Groups and Scale-Out
subtopics: Sending from outside the hub with IHubContext
Scale-out with Redis or Azure SignalR Service
days.lab_task: Build a live auction hub with strongly typed clients, groups per auction, authenticated connections and bids sent from background services, then scale to two servers with a Redis backplane.
checks: Bids reach clients connected to both servers

days.topic: gRPC Services in ASP.NET Core
subtopics: gRPC clients with the client factory
When to choose gRPC over REST
days.lab_task: Build a pricing gRPC service with unary and server-streaming calls, deadlines, an auth interceptor and JSON transcoding, and call it from another ASP.NET Core app.
days.deliverable: gRPC service, client and comparison notes
checks: Client receives a stream of updates
Slow call cancelled at the deadline
Same service callable as JSON over HTTP

days.topic: Token Validation, OpenID Connect and the BFF Pattern in ASP.NET Core
subtopics: Issuer, audience and signing key validation
OpenID Connect sign-in for web apps
Token storage risks in single-page apps
Calling downstream APIs on behalf of users
days.lab_task: Protect an API with JWT bearer validation, add OIDC sign-in to a web app, put a single-page app behind a BFF that keeps tokens on the server and call a downstream API on behalf of the user.
checks: No access tokens stored in the browser
Downstream API receives the user's identity
objectives: Protect single-page apps with a BFF

days.topic: Identity Endpoints, Two-Factor Authentication and Passkeys
subtopics: Identity API endpoints for SPAs and mobile apps
days.lab_task: Expose Identity endpoints for a mobile client, add authenticator-app two-factor with recovery codes, enable passkey sign-in and audit account events.
checks: Code from an authenticator app required
Passkey sign-in succeeds without a password

days.topic: Data Protection, Antiforgery and Secrets
subtopics: Protecting values in cookies and URLs
tools: Redis or Blob Storage key ring
days.lab_task: Persist and share data protection keys across two servers, protect a value in a URL, add antiforgery to an API used by a browser client and move secrets to Key Vault.
checks: Cookies from one server work on the other
Secrets loaded from Key Vault at start-up

days.topic: Versioning Minimal and Controller APIs with Asp.Versioning
days.lab_task: Add v1 and v2 of the order endpoints for both minimal APIs and controllers, publish a document per version, deprecate v1 with sunset headers and block breaking changes in CI.
days.deliverable: Versioned API with documents per version
checks: Each version returns its own contract

days.topic: Health Checks, Readiness and Diagnostics Endpoints
subtopics: Checks for databases, caches and dependencies
days.lab_task: Add liveness and readiness endpoints with checks for the database, Redis and a downstream API, publish results, protect diagnostic endpoints and wire them into Docker health checks.
checks: Readiness fails while liveness stays healthy
Container marked unhealthy when readiness fails

days.topic: Metrics, Tracing and Logging for ASP.NET Core Endpoints
days.lab_task: Export ASP.NET Core metrics and traces with OpenTelemetry, add custom business metrics and spans, link logs to traces and build a dashboard of latency and errors per endpoint.
checks: Trace shows the endpoint, EF Core and HTTP client spans
Orders per minute shown on the dashboard

days.topic: Resilience with Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience and Polly
days.lab_task: Build resilience pipelines for two downstream APIs with retries, timeouts, a circuit breaker and hedging, inject faults and read the resilience telemetry.
checks: Calls fail fast while the dependency is down
Slow calls answered by the hedged attempt

days.topic: Blazor in Depth: Forms, State and Interactivity
subtopics: State containers and persistent component state
days.lab_task: Build a multi-step Blazor form with custom validation, state persisted across prerendering, a cascading theme, JavaScript interop for a chart and error boundaries.
days.deliverable: Blazor feature with notes on state
checks: No duplicate data load after prerendering

days.topic: Localisation and Globalisation in ASP.NET Core
subtopics: Right-to-left layouts in Razor and Blazor
days.lab_task: Localise the site and API messages into English, Hindi and Arabic, localise validation messages, format dates and currencies per culture and test right-to-left pages.
checks: Validation messages appear in the selected language

days.topic: File Handling: Large Uploads, Streaming and Range Requests
subtopics: Range requests for downloads and video
days.lab_task: Accept multi-gigabyte uploads with streaming and MultipartReader, validate file signatures, store files in Blob Storage, serve video with range requests and stream large exports.
checks: Memory stays flat during the upload
File with a fake extension rejected

days.topic: Performance: Kestrel Tuning, Pooling and Benchmarks
subtopics: JSON serialisation options and source generation
days.lab_task: Load test a hot endpoint, remove allocations with pooling and source-generated JSON, fix a sync-over-async call, tune Kestrel and compression and prove the gains.
days.deliverable: Performance report with before and after results
checks: Source-generated JSON faster with fewer allocations
Thread pool starvation gone under load
Throughput higher at the same latency

days.topic: Containers and .NET Aspire for ASP.NET Core Apps
subtopics: .NET Aspire app host and service defaults
days.lab_task: Containerise the API and site with small images, orchestrate them with Redis and PostgreSQL using .NET Aspire, use service discovery and the dashboard, and deploy to Azure Container Apps.
checks: Chiseled images smaller than the default
Logs, traces and metrics for every resource visible
App running in Azure Container Apps

days.topic: Securing ASP.NET Core Apps Against the OWASP Top 10
subtopics: Broken access control in pages and APIs
Injection with raw SQL and EF Core
Cross-site scripting in Razor and Blazor
tools: Security Code Scan or Roslyn analyzers
days.lab_task: Find and fix planted issues: an IDOR, raw SQL injection, unsafe Html.Raw, an SSRF and missing headers, then scan packages and run ZAP in CI.
objectives: Find OWASP risks in ASP.NET Core

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production API and Blazor Admin Portal
days.lab_task: Build a production-style API with versioning, rate limits, caching, background work and resilience, plus a Blazor admin portal with strong authentication and live updates, then present it with telemetry.
checks: API and admin portal work end to end with live updates
Security, performance and test reports meet targets
Pipeline, caching and security choices explained
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one product
Ship a production ASP.NET Core app

advanced.summary: For senior ASP.NET Core engineers and technical leads. Covers hosting and Kestrel internals, routing internals and endpoint metadata, source generators and AOT-safe APIs, multi-tenancy, YARP and gateway patterns, advanced authorization, zero-downtime deployments, distributed sessions and caching, large-scale SignalR, Blazor at scale, certificate and token exchange security, abuse protection, testing strategy, production diagnostics, migration from MVC 5 and Web API 2, hosting at scale, API governance, AI features and incident troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production ASP.NET Core applications
Strong C#, EF Core and security knowledge
Has deployed and operated ASP.NET Core in production
outcomes: Explain and extend ASP.NET Core internals
Architect multi-tenant, secure and scalable ASP.NET Core platforms
Diagnose and fix deep production problems
Lead migrations and API platform decisions

days.topic: ASP.NET Core Internals: Hosting, Kestrel and the Request Pipeline
subtopics: Server-sent events and HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support
days.lab_task: Step through a request from Kestrel to an endpoint, inspect features on HttpContext, read a request body with pipes and enable HTTP/3, explaining each layer.
checks: Each layer from connection to endpoint identified
Large body parsed with low allocations

days.topic: Routing Internals and Endpoint Metadata
subtopics: Route matching and the DFA matcher
Custom route constraints and parameter transformers
days.lab_task: Build a dynamic endpoint data source from configuration, a custom constraint and transformer, attach metadata used by middleware and debug an ambiguous match.
checks: Configured endpoints appear without code changes
Middleware reads endpoint metadata to apply a rule
Ambiguous match resolved with the cause explained

days.topic: Source Generators, Request Delegate Generation and AOT-Safe APIs
subtopics: Why reflection limits AOT and trimming
Request delegate generation for minimal APIs
days.lab_task: Make an API AOT-safe with request delegate generation, JSON and configuration binding generators, fix trimming warnings, write a small generator and compare start-up and memory.
checks: Generator produces the expected code at build
Start-up time and memory compared with JIT

days.topic: Multi-Tenant ASP.NET Core Applications
subtopics: Resolving tenants from hosts, paths or tokens
Tenant isolation in caches and background jobs
days.lab_task: Make the platform multi-tenant with host-based resolution, tenant-scoped options and EF Core contexts, per-tenant sign-in settings and tenant-aware caching, and prove isolation.
checks: No cross-tenant data in pages, APIs or jobs
Each tenant signs in with its own identity provider

days.topic: YARP Reverse Proxy and API Gateway Patterns
subtopics: Authentication and authorisation at the gateway
Rate limiting and caching at the gateway
days.lab_task: Build a YARP gateway with routes to three services, health-based load balancing, header transforms, token checks and rate limits, and use it to strangle an old endpoint.
checks: Requests without tokens stopped at the gateway
Old endpoint replaced without client changes
objectives: Apply cross-cutting rules at the edge

days.topic: Advanced Authorization: Resource-Based Rules, Policy Providers and External Policy Engines
subtopics: External engines such as OPA or OpenFGA
days.lab_task: Implement relationship-based access for shared documents with OpenFGA, a dynamic policy provider for permissions stored in data, audit every decision and test the rules.
checks: Shared users gain access and others do not
Allow and deny decisions recorded with reasons

days.topic: Zero-Downtime Deployments and Database Changes for ASP.NET Core
tools: Azure App Service slots or Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Ship a column rename with expand and contract migrations, deploy with slots or rolling updates while load testing, hide the new behaviour behind a flag and roll back once.
checks: Both versions work during the rollout
Previous version restored without data loss

days.topic: Distributed Caching and Session State at Scale
days.lab_task: Move session state to Redis, design cache keys and invalidation messages for a busy catalogue, handle a Redis outage with fallbacks and monitor hit rates and hot keys.
days.deliverable: Caching and session architecture with test results
checks: Site keeps working with higher latency
Changes visible on all servers within a second

days.topic: Large-Scale SignalR with Azure SignalR Service
days.lab_task: Load test a live scoreboard with 50,000 simulated connections on Azure SignalR Service, tune message batching and group design and record cost and latency.
checks: 50,000 connections held at the target latency
Monthly cost at the tested load calculated

days.topic: Advanced Blazor: Component Libraries, Render Mode Strategy and Performance
subtopics: Render mode strategy for large apps
Building a Razor class library of components
days.lab_task: Build a reusable component library, choose render modes per page for a large app, virtualise a 100,000-row grid, lazy-load WebAssembly assemblies and test components with bUnit.
days.deliverable: Component library and render mode plan

days.topic: Securing APIs: mTLS, Certificate Authentication and Token Exchange
subtopics: mTLS behind proxies and load balancers
days.lab_task: Require client certificates for a partner API behind a proxy, exchange user tokens for downstream service tokens, rotate keys and threat model the platform.
days.deliverable: Threat model and hardened API configuration
checks: Downstream service gets a scoped token for the user
Keys rotated with no failed requests

days.topic: Rate Limiting and Abuse Protection at Scale
subtopics: Limits per tenant, user, key and endpoint
Edge protection with WAF and CDNs
tools: Azure Front Door or Cloudflare WAF
days.lab_task: Implement distributed per-tenant quotas with Redis, protect sign-in against credential stuffing, add edge WAF rules and dashboards that show abuse attempts.
checks: WAF stops the malicious pattern before the app

days.topic: Testing Strategy for ASP.NET Core Platforms
subtopics: Unit, integration, contract and end-to-end tests
days.lab_task: Assess a platform's tests, add contract and snapshot tests, run a soak test, measure mutation score on core logic and set quality gates in the pipeline.
days.deliverable: Test strategy and quality gate configuration
checks: No memory growth over two hours

days.topic: Production Diagnostics with dotnet-counters, dotnet-trace and Dumps
subtopics: Diagnostics tools and when to use each
Thread pool starvation and lock contention
days.lab_task: Collect counters, traces and dumps from a containerised app with dotnet-monitor, find a CPU hot path, a memory leak and lock contention, and fix each.
checks: CPU hot path identified in the trace
Leaking type identified from the dump
Lock contention gone after the fix

days.topic: Migrating from ASP.NET MVC 5 and Web API 2 to ASP.NET Core
subtopics: Shared session and authentication during migration
Replacing HTTP modules and handlers with middleware
Moving from Web API 2 to minimal APIs or controllers
days.lab_task: Migrate part of an MVC 5 and Web API 2 app incrementally behind YARP with shared authentication, replace an HTTP module with middleware and plan the remaining work.
checks: Users move between old and new pages with one sign-in
Plan lists features, risks and order

days.topic: Hosting at Scale: Kubernetes, Container Apps and IIS Farms
subtopics: Hosting options compared for large estates
Azure Container Apps for simpler operations
IIS farms and Application Request Routing
days.lab_task: Run the same app on Kubernetes and Container Apps with autoscaling, compare operations effort and cost with an IIS farm and write a hosting recommendation.
checks: Recommendation covers cost, risk and skills

days.topic: API Platform Governance: Contracts, Deprecation and Developer Portals
subtopics: API design guidelines for many teams
days.lab_task: Write API guidelines as linting rules, publish APIs in a developer portal with products and keys, deprecate an endpoint with a sunset plan and report usage per consumer.
checks: Guideline rules pass for every API
Consumers find, subscribe and call an API

days.topic: AI Features in ASP.NET Core with Microsoft.Extensions.AI
subtopics: Chat clients for Azure OpenAI, OpenAI and local models
Middleware for logging, caching and rate limits on AI calls
days.lab_task: Add a help assistant that streams answers, calls .NET functions for order data, grounds answers in documents from a vector store and logs cost per request.
checks: Assistant returns real order data through a tool
objectives: Add AI features to ASP.NET Core

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production ASP.NET Core Incidents
subtopics: Memory growth and high GC time
Evidence collection without making things worse
days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: thread pool starvation, socket exhaustion, a slow query after a release and memory growth, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Each cause backed by traces, dumps or plans
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Tenant API Platform on ASP.NET Core
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-tenant API platform with a YARP gateway, advanced authorization, mTLS partner access, distributed quotas, AOT-safe services, zero-downtime releases and diagnostics runbooks, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, runbooks and architecture defence
checks: Release completes with no failed requests
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
